Talia (CSM): Quick 15m kickoff for Aurora onboarding. Goal: owners, 30d acceptance criteria, and 3 early-value signals for renewal. Thu 08:30 PT? Agenda: owners, data pre-reqs, success metrics.
Marco (Aurora PO): Thu 08:30 PT works. Two asks: 1) a simple cost proxy for our flows, 2) confirmation who creates sandbox keys.
Jin (Solutions Eng): Eng needs schema + two sanitized example payloads. Also flag: if peak >40 qps we should plan capacity. Example staging auth I'll use once keys are live: `export RW_API_KEY=stg-abc` then a small curl to sanity test.
Priya (Enablement): I can run a 20-min enablement/demo Wed 10:00 PT, record it, and include masking + KMS steps in the runbook.
Talia (CSM): Draft 30-day success criteria to confirm in the sync:
- Staging ingest + two core flows validated end-to-end
- Recorded demo + runbook delivered
- Dashboard with 3 signals for weekly health (flow usage, ingest error rate, median latency)
Risks: data approval delay, quota surprises, retention signoff lag.
OnboardingBot: Calendar event created: "Aurora onboarding intake" Thu 08:30 PT. Invitees: Talia, Marco, Jin, Priya.
Marco (Aurora PO): I'll have infra send sanitized payloads and a retention policy note by EOD Tue. Thanks everyone.
